name: Vestum AB
summary: Vestum AB (publ) engages in the infrastructure, water, and service businesses in Sweden and internationally. Its Infrastructure segment offers specialised work on railway, water and sewage, and other infrastructure. Its Water segment focuses on improving water infrastructure by offering water pumping, distribution, and wastewater management, as well as water filters, pumps, and irrigation systems. Its Services segment is involved in installation and maintenance of HVAC, electricity, and climate control systems. The company was formerly known as WeSC AB (publ) and changed its name to Vestum AB (publ) in June 2021. It was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
